source.access: Anonymous download via the creator page's $0/no-thanks path; no account, email, payment, or purchase used. Original bytes retained unchanged.
source.preview_limitation: Creator screenshot with promotional overlay; not an independent real-product reference.

model_inventory.coordinate_units: Meters per GLTF; creator page publishes no physical dimensions or unit declaration.
model_inventory.coordinate_basis: Model coordinates measured +X depth, +Y vertical, +Z width from the source preview and GLB bounds; no orientation edits applied.
model_inventory.screen_geometry: No separate display primitive or material; the one UV-mapped mesh uses a single image atlas for the whole photographed television. Screen replacement is not established.

dimensions.measurement_note: Parser-derived vertex envelope including node transform; width is Z, height is Y, depth is X. These are GLB bounds only, not independently verified physical dimensions.

candidate_limitations: Low-poly geometric detail despite the high-resolution photo-derived texture.
Source does not identify smart-TV software, ports, controls, or a replaceable display surface.
Visible wordmark-like texture details and depicted product design need separate rights review before use.
